module: Makes the player vehicle's wheels leave a trace in the "surface mask" (SurfaceMaskClipmap, a C++ object that keeps a dynamic mask of the terrain surface, for example flattened grass). Every 0.05 s, for each wheel, it converts the position (wheel axle node) to world and calls maskCircleWorld (first contact) or maskLineWorld (segment since the last position) with a width of 1.8 m (3.2 m in mower mode). It also owns the clipmap lifecycle: tile storage under /temp/levels/<level>/dynamicTiles, recentering on the vehicle, clearing. It offers a mower mode (cut grass particles) and debug tools (console line, "SurfaceMask Pages" ImGui window, 3D outlines of the 16 m pages). Other extensions (for example util_lawnMower) use it as a service via isReady, setCenter, maskCircleWorld and maskLineWorld.
usage:
extensions.load('util_surfaceMaskWheels') -- active as soon as loaded (onExtensionLoaded calls setEnabled(true))
util_surfaceMaskWheels.setMowingEnabled(true)
util_surfaceMaskWheels.setDebugMode(1) -- statistics line in the console every second
notes: Only player 0's vehicle is processed; the data (wheel offsets, previous positions) is kept per vehicle id and removed on onVehicleDestroyed and onVehicleResetted (rebuilt after reset or part changes).

Internal parameters (not exposed but serialized): maskInterval 0.05 s, maskWidth 1.8 m, mowerWidth 3.2 m, flattenStrength 1, markStrength 0.75, mowerMarkStrength 1, movement thresholds per interval minMoveSq 0.04 (0.2 m) and maxMoveSq 100 (10 m; beyond that the wheel is considered teleported and ignored), pageWorldSize 16 m.
Mower mode sends the obj:addParticleByNodesRelative command (particle type 21, 3 particles) to the vehicle for each marked segment.

Debug modes: 0 none, 1 console line (tag surfaceMask) throttled to 1 Hz, 2 full ImGui window plus 3D outlines of the pages around the vehicle. setDebugMode enables C++-side statistics collection only when the mode is > 0.

M.enabled is false at declaration but onExtensionLoaded sets it to true immediately; onSerialize/onDeserialized keep the state across reloads (wheelMaskEnabled, an internal test switch, is not serialized).
All the functions that touch SurfaceMaskClipmap do nothing if this global does not exist (build without clipmap); isReady() checks it.

enabled.desc: true when wheel marking is active (changed by setEnabled/toggle).

setEnabled.desc: Enables or disables wheel marking and resets the timer.

isReady.desc: Indicates whether the SurfaceMaskClipmap object exists. Lets consumer modules skip their work.

setCenter.desc: Recenters the clipmap: the C++ side saves the modified tiles that leave and loads those that enter.

maskCircleWorld.desc: Stamps a disc into the mask.

flatten.desc: Grass flattening strength (0 to 1 based on the values used).

mark.desc: Marking strength (0 to 1 based on the values used).

maskLineWorld.desc: Stamps a thick segment into the mask.

setMowingEnabled.desc: Enables or disables mower mode (width 3.2 m, marking 1, grass particles).

width.desc: Width in meters; nil keeps the current value.

setDebugMode.desc: Chooses the debug mode (0 none, 1 console, 2 window + 3D); the value is clamped to 0..2 and the first console line is emitted right away.

setDebug.desc: Compatibility: true enables mode 2, false mode 0.

cycleDebug.desc: Switches to the next debug mode (0, 1, 2, then back to 0).

setDebugPageRadius.desc: Sets the radius (in pages) of the debug grid displayed around the vehicle (0 = current page only).

getPerformanceStats.desc: Returns a copy of the Lua-side performance statistics.

returns.desc: {maskTicks, lastLuaFrameMs, avgLuaFrameMs, lastLuaMaskMs, avgLuaMaskMs, lastWheelCount, lastMovedWheels, lastSkippedWheels, lastMaskCalls, lastParticleCalls}.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: accumulates the simulated time, runs the player vehicle's wheel marking every maskInterval, then the debug if any.

dtSim.desc: Simulated duration (s), takes priority over dtReal.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on extension load: enables the module, turns off debugging and initializes the tile storage.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called when a level starts: repoints the clipmap's tile storage to the current level.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: removes its wheel data.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called after a vehicle reset: removes its wheel data so it is rebuilt.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before extension reload: returns the state and the parameters (enabled, widths, strengths, thresholds, debug mode, mower, particles).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload with the serialized state; restores the parameters (debug tile size limited to 36).
